metadata.methodology: 15 Intelligence metrics normalized [0,1], averaged → composite ability; Pareto = non-dominated by per-request cost; X-axis: log-normalized cost (ln(cost) mapped to [0,1]); Y-axis: composite ability (linear, direct average)
metadata.arithmetic: All intermediate calculations use fractions.Fraction for exact rational arithmetic; float conversion only at matplotlib coordinate input and JSON serialization

per_request_cost.non_reasoning: Output_tokens = (Total - TTFT) × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
per_request_cost.reasoning_with_time: Output_tokens = (Total - TTFT) × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
per_request_cost.reasoning_no_time: Output_tokens = Total × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
